headline.title: How Endava is redesigning software delivery around AI agents
headline.summary: Endava is leveraging AI agents, including ChatGPT Enterprise and Codex, to enhance software delivery and automate workflows. The company aims to foster an AI-native culture throughout its operations.

articles.title: Alpha School’s Ritzy New York City Campus Costs $65,000 a Year—but Isn’t Actually a School
articles.summary: Alpha School has opened a new homeschooling center in Manhattan, charging $65,000 per year, as part of its nationwide expansion. Internal documents indicate that the company's strategy prioritizes opening dates over safety considerations.

articles.title: Jeff Bezos Is Funding a Wild Hunt for the Brain’s ‘Core Algorithm’
articles.summary: Jeff Bezos is investing $500 million in Flourish, a company aiming to explore the brain's fundamental algorithms by studying real neurons. The startup is currently valued at approximately $2.5 billion as it seeks to innovate in the field of artificial intelligence.

articles.title: Amazon develops a warehouse robot workers can speak to
articles.summary: Amazon has unveiled an upgraded version of its autonomous warehouse robot, Proteus, which allows human workers to interact with it using natural language. This development is part of Amazon's broader strategy to enhance automation in its warehouses, potentially reducing the need for human labor.

articles.title: Quantum Computing Is Having Its Public Market Moment
articles.summary: Quantinuum, a quantum computing startup, is experiencing significant financial losses yet continues to attract investor interest. The growing demand for quantum computing technology is driving investors to seek opportunities in the sector despite the company's current challenges.

articles.title: Lovable signs multiyear deal with Google Cloud to up usage 5x, source says
articles.summary: Lovable has entered into a multiyear agreement with Google Cloud, which will increase its usage by five times and provide enhanced access to Anthropic Claude. This partnership aims to significantly expand Lovable's operational capabilities on the Google Cloud platform.

articles.title: 5 ways Google Search can level up your thrift and vintage shopping
articles.summary: Google Search offers five strategies to enhance thrift and vintage shopping experiences, including using specific search terms and filters to find unique items. The article highlights how these tools can help shoppers discover hidden gems and make informed purchasing decisions.

articles.title: OpenAI and Anthropic Sign Letter to Prevent AI-Developed Biological Weapons
articles.summary: OpenAI and Anthropic, along with other AI leaders, have signed a letter to lawmakers advocating for enhanced tracking of synthetic DNA sequences to prevent the potential development of biological weapons. The initiative aims to address concerns about the misuse of AI in bioweapon creation.

articles.title: Alphabet’s record-breaking $85B raise for Google’s AI business is a helluva good signal
articles.summary: Alphabet has raised a record-breaking $85 billion through a stock sale, indicating strong investor interest in its AI business. This significant funding could enhance Google's capabilities and offerings in the artificial intelligence sector.

articles.title: How do machines learn? Evaluating the AIcon2abs method
articles.summary: The article evaluates the effectiveness of the AIcon2abs method, which aims to enhance public understanding of machine learning among various age groups, including K-12 students. This method utilizes the WiSARD algorithm, a weightless neural network, to simplify the concepts of artificial intelligence.

articles.title: The Biomimetic Architecture of Software 4.0
articles.summary: The article discusses the limitations of current programming paradigms, which are based on outdated execution models that struggle to accommodate modern multi-dimensional, connectionist intelligence. It highlights the need for a new approach, termed Software 4.0, to address the challenges posed by the probabilistic-symbolic impedance mismatch in contemporary systems.

articles.title: SymTRELLIS: Symmetry-Enforced Voxel Latents for 3D Generation
articles.summary: Researchers have introduced SymTRELLIS, a novel method for 3D generation that enforces symmetry in voxel latents to improve the structural integrity of single-view models. This approach addresses the limitations of existing generative models by ensuring compliance with various finite point group symmetries, enhancing their physical usability.
